title: Revisiting Value Iteration: Unified Analysis of Discounted and Average-Reward Cases
abstract: arXiv:2510.23914v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While Value Iteration (VI) is one of the most fundamental algorithms in Reinforcement Learning, its theoretical convergence guarantees still exhibit a persistent mismatch with empirical behavior. In the discounted-reward case, classical theory guarantees geometric convergence with rate $\gamma$, while in the average-reward case recent work suggests that only sublinear convergence can be expected. In practice, however, VI is often observed to converge significantly faster. In this work, we show through a unified geometry-based analysis that, under an assumption of a unique and unichain optimal policy, (i) convergence is geometric in both the discounted- and average-reward settings and (ii) the convergence rate is faster than previous analyses suggest.

translated_title: 重新审视价值迭代：折扣奖励与平均奖励情形的统一分析
translated_abstract: 尽管价值迭代是强化学习中最基础的算法之一，其理论收敛保证与实际经验行为之间仍然存在持续的不匹配。在折扣奖励情形下，经典理论保证以速率 $\gamma$ 进行几何收敛；而在平均奖励情形下，近期研究认为只能期望次线性收敛。然而在实践中，人们经常观察到 VI 的收敛速度显著快于理论预测。在本工作中，我们通过一种统一的基于几何的分析证明：在最优策略唯一且为单链的假设下， 收敛在折扣奖励和平均奖励两种设置下均为几何式的， 其收敛速率快于以往分析所表明的结果。
tldr: 本文通过统一的几何分析证明，在最优策略唯一且为单链的假设下，价值迭代在折扣奖励和平均奖励两种情形下均具有几何收敛性，且收敛速率快于以往理论分析所给出的结果。
en_tdlr: This paper proves via a unified geometry-based analysis that, under an assumption of a unique and unichain optimal policy, Value Iteration converges geometrically in both discounted- and average-reward settings, with faster convergence rates than previously suggested.
